entities.name: Lynde
entities.description: A human warlock and witch from Innistrad, cursed by a planeswalker so that she no longer ages.

entities.name: Traveling mage
entities.description: A powerful planeswalker passing through town who deflected Lynde's curse and returned a curse of their own.

events.summary: Lynde tried to curse a mage who bumped into her; the mage, a planeswalker, deflected it and cursed her back.
events.quote: she attempted to curse a traveling mage

events.summary: Lynde discovered she no longer aged and learned to pass her ailments onto others.
events.quote: Lynde discovered that she no longer aged.

relations.note: The mage cursed her in return after she attempted to curse them.
relations.quote: deflected the curse and sent over a curse of their own
